scope: Two-role software-in-the-loop lifecycle, stage gating, determinism and injected application faults only.

fixture_profile.note: Fixture values are not official timing, geometry, authorization or competition rules.

implementation.stage_integration: TwoRobotMatch accepts optional StageManager; the leased MatchState snapshot is passed read-only to both role callbacks.
implementation.motion_gate: Runner independently zeros both commands unless MatchState.motion_authorized, the assigned stage role matches the endpoint, and the entire tick ends no later than both MatchState.meta.valid_until_ns and stage_ends_at_ns.
implementation.deadline_policy: A tick that straddles the deadline is zeroed in full; no command is extrapolated past authority.
implementation.watchdog_fault: watchdog_healthy=false bypasses both policy callbacks and supplies zero actuation; simulated time advances and stage result is not altered.
implementation.transaction_boundary: Sensor/policy/referee exceptions and invalid paired commands occur before either plant advances; predicted poses are evaluated before commit, and failed ticks do not commit runner time or plant state.
implementation.lifecycle: Cold INIT/FREEZE/ACTIVE, guardian stage, timeout, terminal stop, reset acknowledgement barrier, fresh stage ID and explorer role swap.
implementation.truth_boundary: No referee truth enters policy callbacks. SIM_TRUTH remains unscored unless a stage profile explicitly enables it; no goal zone or ARRIVAL is inferred.
implementation.replay: Fixed sensor seeds and wall fixture produce byte-comparable observation/command/pose tuples across repeated cold runs.

verification.full_regression_command: $env:PYTHONPATH = 'hsl_core;ros_ws\src\hsl_safety'; python -m pytest hsl_core\tests sim\kinematic ros_ws\src\hsl_interfaces\test ros_ws\src\hsl_safety\test -q

limitations: Policy callbacks return raw kinematic Actuation. This runner does not replace or verify OptionAuthority, MotionCandidate validation, the safety supervisor or command mux.
The watchdog fault is a deterministic input to the harness, not an independent process, transport heartbeat, OS-scheduling test or physical stop.
The two roles share one sequential StageManager role assignment; this does not infer simultaneous-event or competition role-swap rules.
A whole deadline-straddling tick is discarded, conservatively losing up to one tick of otherwise authorized movement.
No accepted zone, official start trigger, official duration/scoring/tie rule, or memory-retention approval was supplied.
Passing kinematic tests does not establish MVSim sensor fidelity, ROS/DDS isolation, I08 diagnostics, physical G0-G3 evidence, competition readiness or G4.
next_required_evidence: Wire TacticalSelector proposals through OptionAuthority, leased candidates, safety supervisor and mux in an integrated runtime.
Add bounded diagnostics/HUD and immutable run artifact capture without putting UI work on the control path.
Run ROS launch/topic/namespace/QoS/process fault integration when the pinned runtime is available.
Obtain approved stage/zone/scoring/retention metadata before any arrival or official-result rehearsal.
Repeat the complete profile-specific acceptance matrix in MVSim and hardware; keep G4 blocked until its defined evidence is complete.
